plan.name: The 20-Week Integrated Strength Program (V26.9: Longevity Update)
plan.description: Build elite pulling strength (max pull-ups, pull-up variations) while maintaining all-around capacity (pushing, lower body) and protecting knee/shoulder health. Optimized for the 40+ athlete with Volume Management and Joint Longevity principles.
